doc.title: Mildred Major and Emma Zeno Interview, 1969-03-28

title: Singing at a pop concert with her father's band and Nick
summary: Picnics led to her singing at a pop concert at the Square at about age 18, with Nick, her father's manager; the end of the transcript degenerates into garbled repetition.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Do you remember going on picnics to yourself? Oh, yeah.

He used to take me on picnics with him. And that was another time he tried to make me interested in his music. They were at the Oratorium Square here on Sinan and St. Claude. We had a pop concert. And I sang at the concert. Very nice it was. Had a nice write-up in the items, paper files.
I must have been around 18 years old. About 18. And you sang at the concert? Yeah. Mr. Nick, I don't know if you remember his manager. I used to manage him. I remember Nick.
Well, he was with my father then at that time.
Oh, yes. That would have been in the, that would have been maybe in the early 50s or late 40s.
